name: sparq-monorepo
description: Repo-root npm workspaces for the sparq JavaScript/TypeScript surfaces: the shared @sparq/client (the single wasm Store surface, re-exporting the generated d.ts), the Next.js showcase site, the @jeswr/sparq npm wrapper, and the Tauri GUI e2e harness. The Rust workspace is governed separately by Cargo.toml. [OPUS-4.8] sq-jpki
//type: [OPUS-4.8] sq-jpki — deliberately NO top-level `type` field. Before this root package.json existed, repo-root `.js` files (e.g. scripts/dashboard-smoke.js, which uses CommonJS require()) had no parent manifest and so defaulted to CommonJS. Adding `"type": "module"` here would retroactively flip every such `.js` to ESM and break them. Each workspace member declares its own `type`, so omitting it here changes nothing for them while preserving the historical CommonJS default for the root scripts/ + bench/ .js files.
